stem:
Wafa works with the nonzero base $3$ and the power $3^{-2}$.

Which claim correctly interprets the negative exponent?

options.text: The reciprocal $1/3^{2}$ forces the exponent to be negative, so the negative sign is read off the reciprocal.

teacher.key_rationale: For nonzero base, n^{-a}=1/n^a, so 3^{-2}=1/9. Writing -9 confuses the sign with multiplication/negation. Writing -1/9 over-extends the reciprocal with an extra minus. Saying the reciprocal creates the negative exponent reverses the definition.
